svg.title: United States locator map
svg.desc: Generalized state boundaries with Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico shown in locator insets. Case-study and selected-location markers are added by the web application.
svg.metadata: Source: U.S. Census Bureau 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files, state 1:20,000,000. Locator produced 2026-07-22 by EPR, P.C.'s Timberwing Systems. No scale is shown because this map is for national location context, not distance measurement.
